name: table-demo
title: Table demo
description: Invoices with a caption and a total.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableContainer, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from '@/ui/table/table'; /** Recent invoices, named by a caption, with a total in the footer. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-table-demo', imports: [ Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableContainer, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, ], template: `
@for (invoice of invoices; track invoice.id) { }
A list of your recent invoices.
Invoice Status Method Amount
{{ invoice.id }} {{ invoice.status }} {{ invoice.method }} {{ invoice.amount }}
Total $1,750.00
`, }) export class TableDemoExample { protected readonly invoices = [ { id: 'INV001', status: 'Paid', method: 'Credit card', amount: '$250.00' }, { id: 'INV002', status: 'Pending', method: 'PayPal', amount: '$150.00' }, { id: 'INV003', status: 'Unpaid', method: 'Bank transfer', amount: '$350.00', }, { id: 'INV004', status: 'Paid', method: 'Credit card', amount: '$450.00' }, { id: 'INV005', status: 'Paid', method: 'PayPal', amount: '$550.00' }, ]; }
